status: EXPLORATORY (dev seeds 0/1/3/4, nothing sealed); branch work, not main; advisory only
interpretation: Chance AUC-PR = 0.378. Hypothesis (sensor penalty shrinks at higher native resolution) NOT supported: noise+gamma+blur costs ~0.12 AUC-PR at both 48 px (0.642->0.516) and 112 px (0.737->0.616). Higher resolution is nonetheless a strong overall lever (+0.10 clean, +0.10 sensor), so a noisy 112 px camera matches a clean 48 px one. Full shift improves only modestly (0.452->0.497). Single dev seed; exploratory.
infrastructure: GPU-computed features (cached per split) were checked for finiteness: one frame (episode 191, t 6, 112 px sensor split) was silently NaN with a finite input and no exception -- silent GPU corruption. It was recomputed on CPU and patched. GPU vs CPU features on four checked episodes agree within fp16 storage precision (max |diff| <= 0.016). Heads trained on CPU. Earlier GPU attempts crashed (illegal memory access); see target/vision-wm/infrastructure_failures.jsonl.
